card.name: Small words before study subjects
card.fires_on: Small words such as numbers, 'in', 'by', 'from' or 'any' that come right before a noun for a group being studied, such as rats, infants, patients or soldiers.

modes.label: Number before study group
modes.description: A count word or digit comes just before a group of subjects or studies.
modes.example: A decrease in fertility was seen in one of<< two>> rat studies at a dose of 8

modes.label: Linking word before data source
modes.description: A preposition or 'any' comes before a noun naming trials, pregnancy data or regions.
modes.example: Available data<< from>> case reports in the literature and pharmacov

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts of group nouns and away from the word 'population' and its Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on little words and numbers just before the text names who or what was studied.
